basic_details.job_title: District Court Thalassery Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Office Attendant, Typist Posts
basic_details.short_information: District Court Thalassery has announced 3 contract vacancies for Typist / Computer Assistant and Office Attendant posts, with offline applications to be submitted in person or by post to the District Judge, District Court, Thalassery on or before 28 October 2026 at 5:00 PM. Applicants must have retired from courts or other government departments and must not have completed 62 years of age. The notified pay is Rs. 23,360 for Typist / Computer Assistant and Rs. 20,280 for Office Attendant. The selection process involves scrutiny of applications, qualifications, and an interview.

qualification.details: Vacancy Distribution: Mattannur Fast Track Special Court (POCSO) requires 1 Typist / Computer Assistant; Kannur Fast Track Special Court (POCSO) requires 1 Typist / Computer Assistant and 1 Office Attendant. Department: Civil Judiciary. Eligibility: Candidates must have retired from courts, court-equivalent departments, or other government departments. Preference will be given to those who retired from courts. Age Limit: Candidates must not have completed 62 years of age. content_sections.heading: District Court Thalassery Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: Retired from courts, similar departments, or other government departments

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted along with a detailed biodata and attested copies of certificates. The complete application packet can be delivered in person or sent by post to the following address: District Judge, District Court, Thalassery, PIN- 670101 Applicants must use the prescribed application format provided in the official notification. Candidates must compulsorily mention their mobile number and email ID in the application. For inquiries, candidates may contact via Phone: 04902341008 or Email: [email protected] . Updates and rank lists will be published on the notice board and website of District Court Thalassery.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Vacancy Distribution: Mattannur Fast Track Special Court (POCSO) requires 1 Typist / Computer Assistant; Kannur Fast Track Special Court (POCSO) requires 1 Typist / Computer Assistant and 1 Office Attendant. Department: Civil Judiciary. Eligibility: Candidates must have retired from courts, court-equivalent departments, or other government departments. Preference will be given to those who retired from courts. Age Limit: Candidates must not have completed 62 years of age. Tenure: Appointment is purely on a contract basis for a continuous period of 179 days, or until the candidate attains 62 years of age, whichever comes first. content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Complete biodata including mobile number. Copy of Aadhaar card. Attested copies of certificates proving age/date of birth. Attested copies of educational qualifications and other technical qualifications. Attested copies of work experience certificates. Attested copy of Pension Payment Order (PPO) or pension proof documents.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made in order of priority from a list prepared on the basis of scrutiny of applications, qualifications, and an interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced in District Court Thalassery Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 contract vacancies, comprising 2 posts of Typist / Computer Assistant and 1 post of Office Attendant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications in person or by post at District Court Thalassery is 28 October 2026 before 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates who have retired from courts, court-equivalent departments, or other government departments and have not reached 62 years of age are eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must not have completed 62 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated remuneration is Rs. 23,360 for Typist / Computer Assistant and Rs. 20,280 for Office Attendant.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for District Court Thalassery Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates submit the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit the filled application form and biodata with self-attested copies of certificates either in person or by post to the District Judge, District Court, Thalassery, PIN- 670101.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual appointment?
faq.answer: This is purely a contract appointment for a period of 179 days or until the appointee turns 62 years of age, whichever occurs earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any preference given to specific applicants?
faq.answer: Yes, preference in selection will be given to candidates who have retired from court service.

faq.question: Q10. What documents need to be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must enclose their biodata, copy of Aadhaar card, proof of age, educational and technical qualification certificates, experience certificates, and pension/PPO documents.
